title: Added sound effects and VFX sprite sheets to my game asset library, made with Claude-written code
author: vinishkapoor
selftext:
Alongside the 3D models, my library now has two more sections for game devs.

**Sound effects:** 480 sounds in 30 categories, like UI clicks, coins, 8-bit hits, lasers, explosions, magic spells and horror drones. They're synthesized in code from oscillators, FM and filtered noise, so nothing is recorded or sampled and no AI audio generators were used. WAV, OGG and MP3, with seamless loops and matched loudness.

**VFX:** 160 sprite sheets in 20 categories, like fire, explosions, slashes, lightning, portals and rain overlays. Each one is a 64-frame PNG sheet with a JSON preset, and there are setup notes for Unity, Godot, three.js and Phaser.

CC BY 4.0, no sign-up.

Sounds: [https://vinish.dev/free-sound-effects](https://vinish.dev/free-sound-effects)

VFX: [https://vinish.dev/free-vfx](https://vinish.dev/free-vfx)

comments.author: Emily_Collins89
comments.body: using AI to write procedural generation tools instead of directly generating assets is a pretty clever approach
